sources.entry: Claude Code Guide by zebbern - A current single-page reference for Claude Code: install, environment variables, slash commands, MCP, hooks, and subagents, kept in sync with the official changelog.

summary.one_liner: A single-page, continuously updated reference guide for Claude Code covering installation, environment variables, slash commands, CLI flags, settings, MCP, hooks, and subagents.
summary.what_it_does: The guide is one long Markdown page organized into sections: Getting Started, Configuration and Environment, Commands and Usage, Interface and Input, Advanced Features, Security, Automation, Help and Troubleshooting, and Third-Party Integrations. It lists install methods (native installer, Homebrew, WinGet, npm) and system requirements, and shows authentication setup with the claude auth commands. It includes tables of environment variables, settings file locations and precedence, CLAUDE.md and rules memory types, and a large slash-command and CLI-flag reference. It also documents keyboard shortcuts, Vim mode, and headless print-mode usage with output formats. The README states that commands and provider model mappings change quickly and that the official references are authoritative.
use_cases: Look up a Claude Code slash command or CLI flag
Set up Claude Code and log in on macOS, Linux, or Windows
Find which environment variable controls a setting
Configure project and user CLAUDE.md memory files
Run Claude Code headless in scripts with JSON output
Learn keyboard shortcuts and Vim editing mode in Claude Code
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (native installer on macOS, Linux, or WSL; URL missing from README extract)
notable: Covers the full Claude Code surface in one page: install, env vars, slash commands, CLI flags, MCP, hooks, and subagents
Documents settings precedence (managed policy, CLI, local, project, user) and CLAUDE.md memory scopes
Includes a large CLI flag table with examples for print mode, stream-json output, and worktrees
Notes which features are unavailable when a persistent API key overrides subscription login
caveats: Not official documentation; the README defers to the official Claude Code docs as authoritative
Commands and provider model mappings change quickly, so entries may go stale
Requires a paid Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, or Console account; the free Claude.ai plan lacks Claude Code
